sources.title: API Public Beta
sources.notes: Originally published at https://x.ai/blog/api, which now redirects (308) here. Launches the public beta of the xAI API with the preview model grok-beta.

sources.title: Release Notes
sources.notes: Living page of the xAI API docs (branded SpaceXAI Docs); content as seen on 2026-10-01 (page says last updated September 28, 2026). Entries are grouped by month and each carries a day; month groups from January to September carry no year and belong to 2026, older groups are labelled with their year (December 2025 and earlier); the earliest group is November 2024. The old address https://docs.x.ai/docs/release-notes redirects here (308).

sources.title: SpaceXAI Brand Guidelines

publishedAt.note: Date shown on the page; the text has since been updated to the SpaceXAI name.

sources.notes: HTML title is Brand Guidelines; the page heading reads SpaceXAI Brand Guidelines. States that SpaceXAI is the developer of Grok.

sources.title: Company: Accelerating Scientific Discovery
sources.notes: Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01; the site is branded SpaceXAI. Includes a dated milestone timeline (Our path of progress), with Grok 3 API on Apr 3, 2025. The old address https://x.ai/about redirects here. Both returned 403 to a scripted request on 2026-10-02.

sources.title: Google Cloud Vertex AI
sources.notes: Integration guide in the xAI API docs for Grok on Google Cloud Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Model Garden). Names Grok 4.2 and Grok 4.3 as example models and xai/grok-4.7 as an example model id. Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: Announcing Grok-1.5
sources.notes: Originally published at https://x.ai/blog/grok-1.5, which now redirects (308) here.

sources.title: Grok-1.5 Vision Preview
sources.notes: Originally published at https://x.ai/blog/grok-1.5v, which now redirects (308) here. Also introduces the RealWorldQA benchmark dataset.

sources.title: xai-org/grok-1: Grok open release
sources.notes: xAI's GitHub repository with JAX example code and the model specifications of the Grok-1 open-weights model. The open-release post links https://github.com/xai-org/grok, which redirects (301) here. Repository created 2024-03-17 (GitHub API).

sources.title: xai-org/grok-1
sources.notes: Model repository of the xai-org organisation on Hugging Face holding the Grok-1 weights (Apache 2.0). Its commit history starts on 2024-03-17; the card itself states no date.

sources.title: Grok-1 Model Card

publishedAt.note: The page shows the date of the Announcing Grok post it belongs to.

sources.notes: Linked from the Announcing Grok post. The older address https://x.ai/model-card redirects here; https://x.ai/blog/grok/model-card returns 404.

sources.title: Open Release of Grok-1
sources.notes: Originally published at https://x.ai/blog/grok-os, which now redirects (308) here. Announces the release of the Grok-1 base model weights and architecture under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Bringing Grok to Everyone
sources.notes: Originally published at https://x.ai/blog/grok-1212, which now redirects (308) here. Announces the new version of Grok-2 on X and the API models grok-2-1212 and grok-2-vision-1212.

sources.title: Grok-2 Beta Release
sources.notes: Originally published at https://x.ai/blog/grok-2, which now redirects (308) here. Announces Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini together.

sources.title: xai-org/grok-2
sources.notes: Model repository of the xai-org organisation on Hugging Face with the weights of Grok 2, described as a model trained and used at xAI in 2024; it does not say which Grok-2 version. The card states no date; the commit history shows the initial commit and weight uploads on 2025-08-22 (UTC) and the README on 2025-08-23. The README names the Grok 2 Community License Agreement; the LICENSE file is now titled xAI Community License Agreement (last updated November 4, 2025).

sources.title: Grok 3 Beta — The Age of Reasoning Agents
sources.notes: HTML title carries the site name SpaceXAI; the post heading is used as title. The old address https://x.ai/blog/grok-3 is reported to redirect here (it returned 403 to a scripted request on 2026-10-02). Announces Grok 3 and Grok 3 mini and the beta reasoning models Grok 3 (Think) and Grok 3 mini (Think).

sources.title: Grok 3
sources.notes: xAI API model page for grok-3; the URL now redirects to https://docs.x.ai/developers/models, which no longer lists the model. HTML title of the capture is the generic Welcome to the xAI documentation; the page heading Grok 3 is used. Checked in the capture on 2026-10-02: modalities drawn as icons, text to text; context window 131,072; model name grok-3 with aliases grok-3-latest and grok-3-beta; links a separate grok-3-fast listing.

sources.title: Grok 4.1
sources.notes: Describes a silent rollout of preliminary builds from 1 to 14 November 2025 before the announcement. Links the Grok 4.1 model card.

sources.title: Grok 4.1 Fast and Agent Tools API
sources.notes: Subtitle: Bringing the next generation of tool-calling agents to the xAI API.

sources.title: Grok 4.1 Model Card
sources.notes: PDF. Calls Grok 4.1 an update to Grok 4 and Grok 3 and describes the Thinking and Non-Thinking configurations.

sources.title: Grok 4.20
sources.notes: Per-model page in the xAI API docs (model name grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, aliases, modalities, context window, capabilities, pricing, regions). Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01; a Markdown rendering is served at the same URL with .md appended.

sources.title: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent Beta
sources.notes: Per-model page in the xAI API docs for grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309; the HTML title reads Grok 4.20 Multi Agent, the heading Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent Beta. Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: Grok 4.20 System Card
sources.notes: PDF, 8 pages, dated April 7, 2026 on the first page. It refers to the two deployment modes as Grok 4.2 SA and Grok 4.2 MA. Not linked from the x.ai/safety page when checked on 2026-10-01, which lists model cards for Grok 4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 4 Fast, Code Fast 1 and 4.

sources.title: Grok on Amazon Bedrock
sources.notes: Announces that Grok 4.3 is generally available on Amazon Bedrock. The x.ai site is branded SpaceXAI.

sources.title: Grok 4.3
sources.notes: Per-model page in the xAI API docs (model name grok-4.3, alias grok-4.3-latest, modalities, context window, reasoning efforts, pricing). Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01; it states no release date.

sources.title: Introducing Grok 4.5
sources.notes: The page and the x.ai site are branded SpaceXAI (a doing-business-as name of XAI LLC per the Grok 4.5 model card). Contains benchmark charts with competitor figures.

sources.title: Grok 4.5
sources.notes: Per-model page in the xAI API docs (model name grok-4.5, aliases grok-4.5-latest and grok-build-latest, modalities, context window, reasoning efforts, pricing). Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01.

sources.title: Bringing Grok 4.5 to iOS, Android, Web, and X
sources.notes: Announces Grok 4.5 in the consumer apps: grok.com, X and the Grok apps for iOS and Android.

sources.title: Model Card: Grok 4.5
sources.notes: PDF linked as Grok 4.5 from https://x.ai/safety. The cover gives July 14, 2026 and Revision: 2026-07-20; the file name carries a content hash, so a later revision may get a new URL. The cover date is two days before the announcement of July 16, 2026.

sources.title: Grok
sources.notes: Release notes of the Grok consumer apps; the HTML title is only Grok and the page is rendered client-side. Living page, earliest entry 2025-08-29 when seen on 2026-10-02. Entry used: aug-29-2025 (Grok 4 for anonymous users); the nov-18-2025 entry also lists Grok 4.1 and Grok 4 Fast.

sources.title: Grok Release Notes
sources.notes: Release notes of the Grok consumer apps (grok.com), one dated entry per week; living page, content as seen on 2026-10-02 (entries from 2025-08-29 to 2026-09-12). The page is rendered client-side: the HTML title is only Grok, the page heading is Grok Release Notes. Entries are dated by an anchor such as feb-17-2026.

sources.title: May 15, 2026 Model Retirement
sources.notes: HTML title May 15, 2026 Model Retirement | SpaceXAI Docs; page heading Grok Model Retirement on May 15, 2026. Shows Last updated: September 2, 2026 and no publication date. Lists grok-4-1-fast-reasoning, grok-4-1-fast-non-reasoning, grok-4-fast-reasoning, grok-4-fast-non-reasoning, grok-4-0709, grok-code-fast-1, grok-3 and grok-imagine-image-pro as retired from the xAI API effective May 15, 2026 at 12:00 PM PT; the text slugs redirect to grok-4.3, grok-code-fast-1 to grok-build-0.1. grok-3-mini is not listed.

sources.title: Grok Model Retirement on May 15, 2026
sources.notes: Migration guide in the xAI API docs; HTML title May 15, 2026 Model Retirement. Lists the slugs retired on May 15, 2026 at 12:00 PM PT and their redirect targets (grok-4.3 for the Grok 3, Grok 4, Grok 4 Fast and Grok 4.1 Fast slugs; grok-build-0.1 for grok-code-fast-1). The page states no publication date.

sources.title: Models
sources.notes: Models and pricing overview of the xAI API docs; HTML title Grok Models & Pricing. Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01 (text models listed: grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-4.3, grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning, grok-build-0.1, grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309). https://docs.x.ai/docs/models redirects here.

sources.title: Multi Agent
sources.notes: Guide to Realtime Multi-agent Research with the grok-4.20-multi-agent model in the xAI API docs, including how the agents and the leader agent work and the current limitations. Living page, content as seen on 2026-10-01.
